boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Covers matching, datatype/count, lifetime, ordering/progress, buffering/deadlock, protocol state, flow control, failure/termination, security/privacy, operations, and safety.

evidence: Every receive state accepts only intended context/source/tag/generation and validates actual status, signature, capacity, and schema before effect.
Send/receive regions, requests, datatypes, and communicators remain live and protected until exactly-once completion.
Every wait-for cycle is broken without relying on MPI buffering; application credits bound outstanding messages independent of eager capacity.
Errors/cancellation/partial payloads never authorize commit; termination drains data/credits/requests and external effects deduplicate generations.
invariant_checking.notes: Checked invariants from header construction through matching, transfer, completion, validation, acknowledgment, commit, draining, cancellation/failure, and release.

evidence: Matching proof handles wildcard equivalence or status-bound continuation and rejects cross-context/tag collisions.
Deadlock proof explicitly assumes zero internal buffering/synchronous stress and includes application credit resources.
Ordering proof excludes cross-source/different-pattern/concurrent-thread total order; termination proof distinguishes no-more-sends from all-data-consumed.
